description:
Get Bitcoin Rune transaction activity for a specific Bitcoin address.

Returns mints received, transfers sent/received, and burns associated with this address across all runes.

Address can be any Bitcoin address format (P2WPKH bc1q..., P2TR bc1p..., legacy 1..., etc.)

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

address.description: Bitcoin address to query rune activity for

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-60, default: 20)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

name: runes_get_address_activity
